messages:
Jamie (partnerships): Quick heads up — final runbook for the NebulaCloud co-webinar next Wed. Need short sync on speakers, remote demo fallbacks, and swag routing. Who's on for a 20m check today?
Sasha (events): I can do 3pm PT. Will cover AV run order and stage cueing.
Diego (hw-ops): 3pm PT works. Shipping status on the demo kit: DHL in transit, ETA Thu 10am local. Tracking: https://dhl.example/track/NDL1234567 :package:
Tara (partner-ops): Thanks Diego. FYI customs forms attached on the tracker. Confirmed Nebula's onsite contact is Priya K. (cell shared in doc).
Mina (devex): For the live demo fallback, can Raj share the containerized demo/artifact? We should have a recording ready to play if hardware flakiness happens.
Raj (solutions): I pushed a prod snapshot to S3 and a backup container to our registry. Link: https://s3.example/redwood/nebula-demo/v1.tar.gz and registry ref: registry.redwood/nebula-demo:v1.1
Lin (marketing): Swag plan: 150 sticker packs + 120 demo postcards. swag-bot, can you confirm pickup window from fulfillment?
swag-bot: Pickup scheduled for Fri 9am local. Manifest ID: SWG-7721. Courier: GoShip. ETA to venue: Mon 8pm. :truck:
Jamie (partnerships): Great. Two quick asks before the call: 1) final slide deck by EOD today, 2) one-sentence fallback description we can paste into the host chat for moderators.
Sasha (events): Noted. I'll own the fallback host chat copy. Also want to run a dry mic check with remote speakers 30m before show.
Diego (hw-ops): AV checklist for on-site techs (copying here):
```
- Confirm power + UPS for demo rack
- Verify network: static IP for demo box, NAT rules tested
- Test HDMI -> capture card -> streaming PC
- Validate GPU health & model load times (cold start test)
- Have fallback container running on local laptop
```
Mina (devex): I'll create a one-click fallback script to launch the container and point to the sample data. Will add to the runbook with command: `./start-fallback.sh --sample small-chat`
Raj (solutions): Also leaving a minimal offline token and sample prompt set so demo stays functional w/o cloud. Saved in the runbook under "offline-credentials".
Tara (partner-ops): Logistics note: swag customs forms need invoice value = $5 per pack to avoid delays (worked last time). If anyone needs the paperwork template ping me.
Lin (marketing): Social assets ready — one hero graphic + speaker headshots. Need final speaker bio from Nebula by EOD for partner page.
Jamie (partnerships): On the remote speaker side: Priya will present a 10m overview, then joint live Q&A. Backup for Priya: Nebula's eng lead, Alex. We need Alex on standby and in the Zoom passcode list.
Sasha (events): I'll add Alex to the Zoom invite and give him presenter rights. Also recording will be staged to S3 with retention 30 days.
Diego (hw-ops): If shipping shows any customs hold, fallback is to launch local container + stream demo video. I'll have the video queued on the streaming PC as step 2 of runbook.
Jamie (partnerships): Perfect. Meeting agenda for 3pm PT: 1) confirm slide deck owners, 2) run through AV checklist, 3) confirm fallback playbook, 4) swag pickup & customs, 5) rehearsal schedule.
Mina (devex): One more: post-webinar follow-up template for Nebula customers — we should capture sample prompts + links to the demo repo. I'll draft it.
Lin (marketing): I'll prep the partner co-branded follow-up email. Want to include a promo code for 2 weeks of Redwood Dedicated trial.
Raj (solutions): Minor note — make sure the fallback container's model variant is quantized to fit the laptop GPU memory. I tested v2-qt and it's responsive under 200ms on local.
Sasha (events): See you all at 3pm PT. Jamie — can you paste the Zoom link here so I can attach to calendar?
Jamie (partnerships): Zoom link: https://zoom.example/j/9876543210?pwd=webinar123 — adding to calendar now. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
